0 ![](https://rawgit.com/stathissideris/ditaa/master/doc/images/logo.png) ## DIagrams Through Ascii Art `ditaa` is a small command-line utility that can convert diagrams drawn using ascii art ('drawings' that contain characters that resemble lines like ```| / -``` ), into proper bitmap graphics. This is best illustrated by the following example: ``` +--------+ +-------+ +-------+ | | --+ ditaa +--> | | | Text | +-------+ |diagram| |Document| |!magic!| | | | {d}| | | | | +---+----+ +-------+ +-------+ : ^ | Lots of work | +-------------------------+ ``` After conversion using `ditaa`, the above file becomes: ![](https://rawgit.com/stathissideris/ditaa/master/doc/images/first.png) `ditaa` interprets ASCII art as a series of open and closed shapes, but it also uses special markup syntax to increase the possibilities of shapes and symbols that can be rendered. `ditaa` is open source and free software, released under the GPL license. ## Getting it For Ubuntu, there is a [package](http://packages.ubuntu.com/precise/ditaa). For MacOSX, you can install via [brew](http://brewformulas.org/Ditaa). ## Usage and syntax ### Command line You need the latest Java runtime (JRE) to use `ditaa`. To start from the command line, type (where `XXX` is the version number): `java -jar ditaaXXX.jar` You will be presented with the command-line options help: ``` -A,--no-antialias Turns anti-aliasing off. -b,--background The background colour of the image. The format should be a six-digit hexadecimal number (as in HTML, FF0000 for red). Pass an eight-digit hex to define transparency. This is overridden by --transparent. -d,--debug Renders the debug grid over the resulting image. -E,--no-separation Prevents the separation of common edges of shapes. -e,--encoding The encoding of the input file. -h,--html In this case the input is an HTML file. The contents of the 
 tags are rendered as
                                diagrams and saved in the images directory
                                and a new HTML file is produced with the
                                appropriate  tags.
 -o,--overwrite                 If the filename of the destination image
                                already exists, an alternative name is
                                chosen. Overwrite the image if it exists.
 -r,--round-corners             Causes all corners to be rendered as round
                                corners.
 -s,--scale              A natural number that determines the size of
                                the rendered image. The units are fractions
                                of the default size (2.5 renders 2.5 times
                                bigger than the default).
 -S,--no-shadows                Turns off the drop-shadow effect.
 -t,--tabs                Tabs are normally interpreted as 8 spaces
                                but it is possible to change that using this
                                option. It is not advisable to use tabs in
                                your diagrams.
 -T,--transparent               Causes the diagram to be rendered on a
                                transparent background. Overrides
                                --background.
 -v,--verbose                   Makes ditaa more verbose.
 -W,--fixed-slope               Makes sides of parallelograms and trapezoids
                                fixed.
```

### Syntax

#### Recognized shapes

The following shapes are recognized by `ditaa`:

- **Document** `{d}`: A shape with a wavy bottom edge
- **Storage** `{s}`: A cylindrical shape (database-like)
- **Ellipse** `{o}`: An oval/ellipse shape
- **Manual operation** `{mo}`: A shape with a slanted top
- **Decision** `{c}` ("Choice"): A diamond shape
- **Trapezoid** `{tr}`: A trapezoid shape
- **Input/Output** `{io}`: A parallelogram shape

Example:

```
+--------+   
|{d}     |   
|        |   
+--------+   
```

![](https://rawgit.com/stathissideris/ditaa/master/doc/images/document.png)

#### Color

`ditaa` recognizes color codes:

- `cRED` - Red
- `cGRE` - Green
- `cBLU` - Blue
- `cPNK` - Pink
- `cYEL` - Yellow
- `cBLK` - Black

Example:

```
+---------+
| cBLU    |
|         |
|    +----+
|    |cPNK|
|    |    |
+----+----+
```

![](https://rawgit.com/stathissideris/ditaa/master/doc/images/color.png)

Common edge separation (default):

![](https://rawgit.com/stathissideris/ditaa/master/doc/images/separation.png)

No separation (with the `-E` option):

![](https://rawgit.com/stathissideris/ditaa/master/doc/images/no_separation.png)

#### Dashed lines

Any lines that contain either at least one `=` (for horizontal lines) or at least one `:` (for vertical lines) are rendered as dashed lines. Only one of those characters can make a whole line dashed, so this feature "spreads". The rationale behind this is that you only have to change one character to switch from normal to dashed line, and vice versa.

Example:

```
----+  /----\  +----+
    :  |    |  :    |
    |  |    |  |{s} |
    v  \-=--+  +----+
```

![](https://rawgit.com/stathissideris/ditaa/master/doc/images/dashed_demo.png)

#### Point markers

If `*` is encountered on a line (but not at the end of the line), it is rendered as a special marker, called the point marker. Example:

```
*----*
|    |      /--*
*    *      |
|    |  -*--+
*----*
```

![](https://rawgit.com/stathissideris/ditaa/master/doc/images/point_marker.png)

#### Text handling

If the pattern ' o XXXXX' is encountered, where XXXXX is any text, the 'o' is interpreted and rendered as a bullet point. Note that there must be a space before the 'o' as well as after it.

Example:

```
/-----------------\
| Things to do    |
| cGRE            |
| o Cut the grass |
| o Buy jam       |
| o Fix car       |
| o Make website  |
\-----------------/
```

![](https://rawgit.com/stathissideris/ditaa/master/doc/images/bullet.png)

#### HTML mode

When `ditaa` is run using the `--html` option, the input is an HTML file. The contents of the `
` tags are rendered as diagrams and saved in the images directory and a new HTML file is produced with the appropriate `` tags.

If the id parameter is present in the `
` tag, its value is used as the filename of the rendered png. Otherwise a filename of the form `ditaa_diagram_X.png` is used, where X is a number.

In this mode, files that exist are not generated again, they are just skipped. You can force overwrite of the files using the `--overwrite` option.

See LICENSE file for details.

        elif f==2:

        elif f==3:

        if f==1:
            for x in range(bpp,stride): line[x]=(line[x]+line[x-bpp])&255
        elif f==2:
            for x in range(stride): line[x]=(line[x]+prev[x])&255
        elif f==3:
            for x in range(stride):

                line[x]=(line[x]+((a+prev[x])>>1))&255

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/t')
from lib import load
w,h,px=load('/tmp/t/a5_$s.png')
print('size',w,h)
ys=[y for y in range(h) if any(px[y][x][0]<250 for x in range(w))]
xs=[x for x in range(w) if any(px[y][x][0]<250 for y in range(h))]
print('ink bbox x',min(xs),max(xs),'y',min(ys),max(ys))
"; done

import sys, math, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/t')
from lib import load

w,h,px=load('/tmp/t/a5_4.png')
# observed alpha for rows 113..170, x 140..180
X0,X1,Y0,Y1=140,180,112,172
obs=[[ (254-px[y][x][0])/254.0 for x in range(X0,X1)] for y in range(Y0,Y1)]

def cov_quad(pts, x, y, sub=8):
    # pts: list of 4 (x,y) convex polygon in order
    n=0
    for i in range(sub):
        for j in range(sub):
            sx=x+(i+0.5)/sub; sy=y+(j+0.5)/sub
            if inside(pts,sx,sy): n+=1
    return n/(sub*sub)

def inside(poly,px_,py):
    n=len(poly); s=0
    for i in range(n):
        x1,y1=poly[i]; x2,y2=poly[(i+1)%n]
        cr=(x2-x1)*(py-y1)-(y2-y1)*(px_-x1)
        if cr<0: return False
    return True

def model(params):
    x0,y0,x1,y1,W=params
    dx,dy=x1-x0,y1-y0
    L=math.hypot(dx,dy)
    ux,uy=dx/L,dy/L
    nx,ny=-uy,ux
    qx,qy=nx*W/2,ny*W/2
    pts=[(x0+qx,y0+qy),(x1+qx,y1+qy),(x1-qx,y1-qy),(x0-qx,y0-qy)]
    return pts

def err(params, sub=4):
    pts=model(params)
    e=0.0
    for yy in range(Y0,Y1):
        for xx in range(X0,X1):
            c=cov_quad(pts,xx,yy,sub)
            e+=(c-obs[yy-Y0][xx-X0])**2
    return e

# initial guess from observation
best=None
random.seed(1)
# search around plausible values

cur=list(p0); c=err(cur)
step=[1.0,1.0,1.0,1.0,0.5]
for it in range(4000):
    improved=False
    for i in range(5):
        for s in (step[i],-step[i]):
            trial=list(cur); trial[i]+=s
            e=err(trial)
            if e<c:
                cur=trial; c=e; improved=True
    if not improved:
        step=[s/2 for s in step]
        if max(step)<0.02: break
print('best',cur,'err',c)
pts=model(cur)
for p in pts: print('corner',p)

import sys, math, random

from lib import load

obs=[[ (254-px[y][x][0])/254.0 for x in range(X0,X1)] for y in range(Y0,Y1)]

def cov_quad(pts, x, y, sub=8):
    # pts: list of 4 (x,y) convex polygon in order
    n=0
    for i in range(sub):
        for j in range(sub):
            sx=x+(i+0.5)/sub; sy=y+(j+0.5)/sub
            if inside(pts,sx,sy): n+=1
    return n/(sub*sub)

def inside(poly,px_,py):
    n=len(poly); s=0
    for i in range(n):
        x1,y1=poly[i]; x2,y2=poly[(i+1)%n]
        cr=(x2-x1)*(py-y1)-(y2-y1)*(px_-x1)
        if cr<0: return False
    return True

def model(params):
    x0,y0,x1,y1,W=params
    dx,dy=x1-x0,y1-y0
    L=math.hypot(dx,dy)
    ux,uy=dx/L,dy/L
    nx,ny=-uy,ux
    qx,qy=nx*W/2,ny*W/2
    pts=[(x0+qx,y0+qy),(x1+qx,y1+qy),(x1-qx,y1-qy),(x0-qx,y0-qy)]
    return pts

    pts=model(params)
    e=0.0
    for yy in range(Y0,Y1):
        for xx in range(X0,X1):
            c=cov_quad(pts,xx,yy,sub)
            e+=(c-obs[yy-Y0][xx-X0])**2
    return e

# initial guess from observation

random.seed(1)
# search around plausible values

p0=[159.0,117.0,146.0,166.0,6.5]

for it in range(4000):
    improved=False
    for i in range(5):
        for s in (step[i],-step[i]):
            trial=list(cur); trial[i]+=s
            e=err(trial)

    if not improved:

        if max(step)<0.02: break

for p in pts: print('corner',p)

import sys, math, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/t')
from lib import load

w,h,px=load('/tmp/t/a5_4.png')
X0,X1,Y0,Y1=140,180,112,172

def inside(poly,px_,py):
    n=len(poly); pos=0; neg=0
    for i in range(n):
        x1,y1=poly[i]; x2,y2=poly[(i+1)%n]
        cr=(x2-x1)*(py-y1)-(y2-y1)*(px_-x1)
        if cr>0: pos+=1
        elif cr<0: neg+=1
    return pos==0 or neg==0

def cov_quad(pts, x, y, sub=6):
    n=0
    for i in range(sub):
        for j in range(sub):
            sx=x+(i+0.5)/sub; sy=y+(j+0.5)/sub
            if inside(pts,sx,sy): n+=1
    return n/(sub*sub)

def model(params):
    x0,y0,x1,y1,W=params
    dx,dy=x1-x0,y1-y0
    L=math.hypot(dx,dy)
    ux,uy=dx/L,dy/L
    nx,ny=-uy,ux
    qx,qy=nx*W/2,ny*W/2
    return [(x0+qx,y0+qy),(x1+qx,y1+qy),(x1-qx,y1-qy),(x0-qx,y0-qy)]

def err(params, sub=4):
    pts=model(params)
    e=0.0
    for yy in range(Y0,Y1):
        for xx in range(X0,X1):
            c=cov_quad(pts,xx,yy,sub)
            e+=(c-obs[yy-Y0][xx-X0])**2
    return e

        for s in (step[i],-step[i]):
            trial=list(cur); trial[i]+=s
            e=err(trial)
            if e<c:
                cur=trial; c=e; improved=True
    if not improved:

Model: x=146..153 are 0 (full ink!) — that's totally wrong vs obs (254 = no ink). So the model has ink at x=146..160 at y=118 while obs has ink at 154..160.

So err should be huge for that row alone: 8 pixels with |254-0| = 254 → coverage error 1.0 each → 8.0 squared error. But total err = 2.74. Contradiction! Unless the printing is misaligned.

Oh! I bet the print of the model uses `cov_quad(pts,x,y,6)` for x in range(146,162) → 16 values, and obs prints px[y][x][0] for x in 146..161. The model row 118 shows 16 values: "0 0 0 0 0 0 0 0 169 254 254 254 190 113 35 0" — that's 16 values. Hmm.

Hmm, so the model gives full ink at x=146..153. That's a big error. Unless... the corners I printed are wrong: corner (145.214, 167.876) and (154.786, 117.061), (139.286, 165.999), (160.714, 118.939). At y=118, the quad's x-range: the left edge goes from (154.786,117.061) to (139.286,165.999) → at y=118: x = 154.786 + (139.286-154.786)*(118-117.061)/(165.999-117.061) = 154.786 - 15.5*0.0192 = 154.489. So the print must be misaligned. OH WAIT. Let me test: point (146.5, 118.5) with the quad corners. The quad is convex; a point far to the left should give mixed signs → not inside. Hmm.

v1 = B+n - A+n = (-15.5, 48.938)
v2 = B-n - (B+n) = (5.93, 1.878)
cross(v1,v2) = -15.5*1.878 - 48.938*5.93 = -29.1 - 290.2 = -319.3 < 0 (clockwise)
v3 = A-n - (B-n) = (15.5, -48.938)
cross(v2,v3) = 5.93*(-48.938) - 1.878*15.5 = -290.2-29.1 = -319.3 <0 ✓
v4 = A+n - (A-n) = (-5.93,-1.878)
cross(v3,v4) = 15.5*(-1.878) - (-48.938)(-5.93) = -29.1-290.2 <0 ✓
OK so it's convex clockwise. 

Then a point at (146.5, 118.5): for each edge, cr = (x2-x1)*(py-y1)-(y2-y1)*(px-x1). For clockwise orientation, points inside give cr<0 (since for clockwise, the interior is to the right). function.arguments:
{"command": "cd /workspace && for s in 1 2 3 5; do ./executable -s $s /tmp/t/a5.txt /tmp/t/a5_$s.png 2>&1 | tail -1; done
cat > /tmp/t/fit2.py <<'EOF'
import sys, math
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/t')
from fit import fit, model, cov_quad
from lib import load
for s in [1,2,3,4,5]:
    f='/tmp/t/a5_%d.png'%s
    w,h,px=load(f)
    # find ink bbox for the first diagonal (upper half of image)
    ys=[y for y in range(h) if any(px[y][x][0]<250 for x in range(w))]
    ytop=min(ys)
    # first segment: rows from ytop while contiguous-ish
    xs=[x for x in range(w) if any(px[y][x][0]<250 for y in range(ytop,min(ytop+int(3.5*14*s),h)))]
    print('scale',s,'size',w,h,'first seg bbox x',min(xs),max(xs),'y',ytop, )
    cur,c=fit(f, max(0,min(xs)-6), min(w,max(xs)+7), ytop-int(0.4*14*s), ytop+int(3.3*14*s), [ (20+(1+0.5)*10*s)+2.0, 28*s+ (0.5*14*s)-2.0, (20+0.5*10*s)-2.0, 28*s+(1.5*14*s), 1.55*s])
    print('   fit',[round(v,4) for v in cur],'err',round(c,4))
    pts=model(cur)
    print('   corners',[(round(p[0],3),round(p[1],3)) for p in pts])
EOF
python3 /tmp/t/fit2.py"}

import sys, math, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/t')
from fit import model, cov_quad
from lib import load

def nm(fitfn, p0, steps, iters=200):
    # simple Nelder-Mead
    n=len(p0)
    pts=[list(p0)]
    for i in range(n):
        q=list(p0); q[i]+=steps[i]; pts.append(q)
    vals=[fitfn(p) for p in pts]
    for it in range(iters):
        order=sorted(range(n+1), key=lambda i: vals[i])
        pts=[pts[i] for i in order]; vals=[vals[i] for i in order]
        if abs(vals[-1]-vals[0])<1e-9: break
        centroid=[sum(pts[i][j] for i in range(n))/n for j in range(n)]
        refl=[centroid[j]+(centroid[j]-pts[-1][j]) for j in range(n)]
        vr=fitfn(refl)
        if vr<vals[0]:
            exp=[centroid[j]+2*(centroid[j]-pts[-1][j]) for j in range(n)]
            ve=fitfn(exp)
            if ve<vr: pts[-1],vals[-1]=exp,ve
            else: pts[-1],vals[-1]=refl,vr
        elif vr<vals[-2]:
            pts[-1],vals[-1]=refl,vr
        else:
            con=[centroid[j]+0.5*(pts[-1][j]-centroid[j]) for j in range(n)]
            vc=fitfn(con)
            if vc<vals[-1]: pts[-1],vals[-1]=con,vc
            else:
                for i in range(1,n+1):
                    pts[i]=[pts[0][j]+0.5*(pts[i][j]-pts[0][j]) for j in range(n)]
                    vals[i]=fitfn(pts[i])
    order=sorted(range(n+1), key=lambda i: vals[i])
    return pts[order[0]], vals[order[0]]

import sys, math
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/t')
from fit import model, cov_quad
from lib import load
from nm import nm

def guess(f):
    w,h,px=load(f)
    ink={}
    for y in range(h):
        row=[254-px[y][x][0] for x in range(w)]
        tot=sum(row)
        if tot>0: ink[y]=(tot,sum(x*v for x,v in enumerate(row))/tot)
    ys=sorted(ink)
    runs=[];cur=[ys[0]]
    for y in ys[1:]:
        if y==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(y)
        else: runs.append(cur);cur=[y]
    runs.append(cur)
    run=max(runs,key=lambda r:sum(ink[y][0] for y in r))
    y0,y1=run[0],run[-1]
    tots=[ink[y][0]/254.0 for y in run]
    cxs=[ink[y][1] for y in run]
    n=len(run)
    my=sum(range(n))/n
    mxx=sum((i-my)*(cxs[i]-sum(cxs)/n) for i in range(n))/sum((i-my)**2 for i in range(n))
    b=sum(cxs)/n-mxx*(y0+my)
    W=sum(tots)/n/math.sqrt(1+mxx**2)
    # estimate y_top, y_bot: assume caps perpendicular; total ink = W*L ; L = (y1-y0+?)*sqrt(1+m^2)
    # derive from total ink
    T=sum(tots)
    L=T/W
    dy=L/math.sqrt(1+mxx**2)
    return mxx,b,W,y0,y1,dy

def fitfile(f, X0,X1,Y0,Y1, p0):
    w,h,px=load(f)
    obs=[[ (254-px[y][x][0])/254.0 for x in range(X0,X1)] for y in range(Y0,Y1)]
    def err(params, sub=3):
        try:
            pts=model(params)
        except Exception:
            return 1e9
        e=0.0
        for yy in range(Y0,Y1):
            for xx in range(X0,X1):
                e+=(cov_quad(pts,xx,yy,sub)-obs[yy-Y0][xx-X0])**2
        return e
    steps=[0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.3]
    best,val=nm(lambda p: err(p), p0, steps, iters=250)
    return best,val,obs

for s in [1,2,3,4,5]:
    f='/tmp/t/a5_%d.png'%s
    m,b,W,y0,y1,dy=guess(f)
    print('scale',s,'guess m=%.4f b=%.3f W=%.4f rows %d..%d dy=%.2f'%(m,b,W,y0,y1,dy))
    # initial params: x at y0: x = b+m*y0
    p0=[b+m*y0+0.0, y0+0.3, b+m*(y1+dy), y1+dy+0.3, W]
    w,h,px=load(f)
    xs=[x for x in range(w) if any(px[y][x][0]<250 for y in range(y0-1,y1+2))]
    X0=max(0,min(xs)-4); X1=min(w,max(xs)+5)
    best,val,obs=fitfile(f,X0,X1,y0-3,min(h,y1+4),p0)
    print('   params',[round(v,4) for v in best],'err %.4f'%val)
    pts=model(best)
    print('   corners',[(round(p[0],3),round(p[1],3)) for p in pts])

import sys, math, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/t')
from fit import model, cov_quad
from lib import load

def nm(fitfn, p0, steps, iters=200):
    # simple Nelder-Mead
    n=len(p0)
    pts=[list(p0)]
    for i in range(n):
        q=list(p0); q[i]+=steps[i]; pts.append(q)
    vals=[fitfn(p) for p in pts]
    for it in range(iters):
        order=sorted(range(n+1), key=lambda i: vals[i])
        pts=[pts[i] for i in order]; vals=[vals[i] for i in order]
        if abs(vals[-1]-vals[0])<1e-9: break
        centroid=[sum(pts[i][j] for i in range(n))/n for j in range(n)]
        refl=[centroid[j]+(centroid[j]-pts[-1][j]) for j in range(n)]
        vr=fitfn(refl)
        if vr<vals[0]:
            exp=[centroid[j]+2*(centroid[j]-pts[-1][j]) for j in range(n)]
            ve=fitfn(exp)
            if ve<vr: pts[-1],vals[-1]=exp,ve
            else: pts[-1],vals[-1]=refl,vr
        elif vr<vals[-2]:
            pts[-1],vals[-1]=refl,vr
        else:
            con=[centroid[j]+0.5*(pts[-1][j]-centroid[j]) for j in range(n)]
            vc=fitfn(con)
            if vc<vals[-1]: pts[-1],vals[-1]=con,vc
            else:
                for i in range(1,n+1):
                    pts[i]=[pts[0][j]+0.5*(pts[i][j]-pts[0][j]) for j in range(n)]
                    vals[i]=fitfn(pts[i])
    order=sorted(range(n+1), key=lambda i: vals[i])
    return pts[order[0]], vals[order[0]]

import sys, math
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/t')
from fit import model, cov_quad
from lib import load
from nm import nm

def guess(f):
    w,h,px=load(f)
    ink={}
    for y in range(h):
        row=[254-px[y][x][0] for x in range(w)]
        tot=sum(row)
        if tot>0: ink[y]=(tot,sum(x*v for x,v in enumerate(row))/tot)
    ys=sorted(ink)
    runs=[];cur=[ys[0]]
    for y in ys[1:]:
        if y==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(y)
        else: runs.append(cur);cur=[y]
    runs.append(cur)
    run=max(runs,key=lambda r:sum(ink[y][0] for y in r))
    y0,y1=run[0],run[-1]
    tots=[ink[y][0]/254.0 for y in run]
    cxs=[ink[y][1] for y in run]
    n=len(run)
    my=sum(range(n))/n
    mxx=sum((i-my)*(cxs[i]-sum(cxs)/n) for i in range(n))/sum((i-my)**2 for i in range(n))
    b=sum(cxs)/n-mxx*(y0+my)
    W=sum(tots)/n/math.sqrt(1+mxx**2)
    # estimate y_top, y_bot: assume caps perpendicular; total ink = W*L ; L = (y1-y0+?)*sqrt(1+m^2)
    # derive from total ink
    T=sum(tots)
    L=T/W
    dy=L/math.sqrt(1+mxx**2)
    return mxx,b,W,y0,y1,dy

def fitfile(f, X0,X1,Y0,Y1, p0):
    w,h,px=load(f)
    obs=[[ (254-px[y][x][0])/254.0 for x in range(X0,X1)] for y in range(Y0,Y1)]
    def err(params, sub=3):
        try:
            pts=model(params)
        except Exception:
            return 1e9
        e=0.0
        for yy in range(Y0,Y1):
            for xx in range(X0,X1):
                e+=(cov_quad(pts,xx,yy,sub)-obs[yy-Y0][xx-X0])**2
        return e
    steps=[0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.3]
    best,val=nm(lambda p: err(p), p0, steps, iters=250)
    return best,val,obs

for s in [1,2,3,4,5]:
    f='/tmp/t/a5_%d.png'%s
    m,b,W,y0,y1,dy=guess(f)
    print('scale',s,'guess m=%.4f b=%.3f W=%.4f rows %d..%d dy=%.2f'%(m,b,W,y0,y1,dy))
    # initial params: x at y0: x = b+m*y0
    p0=[b+m*y0+0.0, y0+0.3, b+m*(y1+dy), y1+dy+0.3, W]
    w,h,px=load(f)
    xs=[x for x in range(w) if any(px[y][x][0]<250 for y in range(y0-1,y1+2))]
    X0=max(0,min(xs)-4); X1=min(w,max(xs)+5)
    best,val,obs=fitfile(f,X0,X1,y0-3,min(h,y1+4),p0)
    print('   params',[round(v,4) for v in best],'err %.4f'%val)
    pts=model(best)
    print('   corners',[(round(p[0],3),round(p[1],3)) for p in pts])

import sys, math
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/t')
from fit import model, cov_quad
from lib import load
from nm import nm

def guess(f):
    w,h,px=load(f)
    ink={}
    for y in range(h):
        row=[254-px[y][x][0] for x in range(w)]
        tot=sum(row)
        if tot>0: ink[y]=(tot,sum(x*v for x,v in enumerate(row))/tot)
    ys=sorted(ink)
    runs=[];cur=[ys[0]]
    for y in ys[1:]:
        if y==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(y)
        else: runs.append(cur);cur=[y]
    runs.append(cur)
    run=max(runs,key=lambda r:sum(ink[y][0] for y in r))
    y0,y1=run[0],run[-1]
    tots=[ink[y][0]/254.0 for y in run]
    cxs=[ink[y][1] for y in run]
    n=len(run)
    my=sum(range(n))/n
    mxx=sum((i-my)*(cxs[i]-sum(cxs)/n) for i in range(n))/sum((i-my)**2 for i in range(n))
    b=sum(cxs)/n-mxx*(y0+my)
    W=sum(tots)/n/math.sqrt(1+mxx**2)
    # estimate y_top, y_bot: assume caps perpendicular; total ink = W*L ; L = (y1-y0+?)*sqrt(1+m^2)
    # derive from total ink
    T=sum(tots)
    L=T/W
    dy=L/math.sqrt(1+mxx**2)
    return mxx,b,W,y0,y1,dy

def fitfile(f, X0,X1,Y0,Y1, p0):
    w,h,px=load(f)
    obs=[[ (254-px[y][x][0])/254.0 for x in range(X0,X1)] for y in range(Y0,Y1)]
    def err(params, sub=3):

        e=0.0
        for yy in range(Y0,Y1):
            for xx in range(X0,X1):
                e+=(cov_quad(pts,xx,yy,sub)-obs[yy-Y0][xx-X0])**2
        return e

import sys, math
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/t')
from fit import model, cov_quad
from lib import load

def fitfile(f, X0,X1,Y0,Y1, p0, steps=(0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.25), tol=0.005, sub=4):
    w,h,px=load(f)
    obs=[[ (254-px[y][x][0])/254.0 for x in range(X0,X1)] for y in range(Y0,Y1)]
    def err(params):
        pts=model(params)
        e=0.0
        for yy in range(Y0,Y1):
            for xx in range(X0,X1):
                e+=(cov_quad(pts,xx,yy,sub)-obs[yy-Y0][xx-X0])**2
        return e
    cur=list(p0); c=err(cur); step=list(steps)
    while True:
        improved=False
        for i in range(5):
            for sg in (step[i],-step[i]):
                trial=list(cur); trial[i]+=sg
                e=err(trial)
                if e<c: cur=trial; c=e; improved=True
        if not improved:
            step=[s/2 for s in step]
            if max(step)<tol: break
    return cur,c

if __name__=='__main__':
    s4=[157.75,118.0,142.25,166.938,6.219]

        X0=int(min(p0[0],p0[2]))-6; X1=int(max(p0[0],p0[2]))+7

def fitfile(f, X0,X1,Y0,Y1, p0, steps=(0.25,0.25,0.25,0.25,0.1), tol=0.002, sub=6):
    w,h,px=load(f)
    obs=[[ (254-px[y][x][0])/254.0 for x in range(X0,X1)] for y in range(Y0,Y1)]
    def err(params):
        pts=model(params)
        e=0.0
        for yy in range(Y0,Y1):
            for xx in range(X0,X1):
                e+=(cov_quad(pts,xx,yy,sub)-obs[yy-Y0][xx-X0])**2
        return e
    cur=list(p0); c=err(cur); step=list(steps)
    while True:
        improved=False
        for i in range(5):
            for sg in (step[i],-step[i]):
                trial=list(cur); trial[i]+=sg
                e=err(trial)
                if e<c: cur=trial; c=e; improved=True
        if not improved:
            step=[s/2 for s in step]
            if max(step)<tol: break
    return cur,c,obs

import sys, math
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/t')
from fit import model, cov_quad
from lib import load

def fitfile(f, X0,X1,Y0,Y1, p0, steps=(0.25,0.25,0.25,0.25,0.1), tol=0.002, sub=6):
    w,h,px=load(f)
    obs=[[ (254-px[y][x][0])/254.0 for x in range(X0,X1)] for y in range(Y0,Y1)]
    def err(params):
        pts=model(params)
        e=0.0
        for yy in range(Y0,Y1):
            for xx in range(X0,X1):
                e+=(cov_quad(pts,xx,yy,sub)-obs[yy-Y0][xx-X0])**2
        return e
    cur=list(p0); c=err(cur); step=list(steps)
    while True:
        improved=False
        for i in range(5):
            for sg in (step[i],-step[i]):
                trial=list(cur); trial[i]+=sg
                e=err(trial)
                if e<c: cur=trial; c=e; improved=True
        if not improved:
            step=[s/2 for s in step]
            if max(step)<tol: break
    return cur,c,obs

if __name__=='__main__':
    f='/tmp/t/a6.png'
    # isolated "/" at scale 1, cell (2,2): x 40..50, y 56..70, ink rows 57..68

        r=[round((mi-oi)*254,1) for mi,oi in zip(m,o)]
        print('%-6d'%yy, ' '.join('%6.1f'%v for v in r))

cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/t/glyphmetrics.py <<'EOF'
import sys, re
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/t')
from lib import load
f=sys.argv[1]; svgf=sys.argv[2]
w,h,px=load(f)
svg=open(svgf).read()
texts=re.findall(r"<text x='(\d+)' y='(\d+)' font-family='Courier' font-size='(\d+)' stroke='none' fill='([^']*)' ><!\[CDATA\[(.*?)\]\]>",svg)
print('ntexts',len(texts))
def runs(y,thr=20):
    ink=[254-px[y][x][0] for x in range(w)]
    out=[];cur=None
    for i,v in enumerate(ink):
        if v>thr and cur is None: cur=i
        if v<=thr and cur is not None: out.append((cur,i-1)); cur=None
    if cur is not None: out.append((cur,len(ink)-1))
    return out
res=[]
for (x,y,size,fill,txt) in texts:
    x0=int(x); base=float(y); s=int(size)
    ch=txt[0]
    # find vertical extent in x0..x0+? using the first glyph columns
    ys=[]
    for yy in range(h):
        seg=[px[yy][xx][0] for xx in range(x0,x0+int(s)) if xx<w]
        if any(v<254 for v in seg): ys.append(yy)
    ytop,ybot=min(ys),max(ys)
    # advance from runs in the baseline area
    adv=None
    for yy in range(int(base)-3, int(base)+4):
        r=[t for t in runs(yy) if t[0]>x0]
        if len(r)>=3:
            d=[r[i+1][0]-r[i][0] for i in range(len(r)-1)]
            from collections import Counter
            adv=Counter(d).most_common(1)[0][0]
            break
    print('%-3s size=%3d x=%4d base=%.1f  yext=%d..%d (%d)  adv=%s  inkw=%d'%(ch,s,x0,base,ytop,ybot,ybot-ytop+1,adv, (r[0][1]-r[0][0]+1) if r else -1))
    res.append((ch,s,adv,ytop,ybot))
EOF
python3 /tmp/t/glyphmetrics.py /tmp/t/t4.png /tmp/t/t4.svg 2>&1 | head -70

import ctypes, ctypes.util, os
FT=ctypes.CDLL("libfreetype.so.6")
class FT_LibraryRec(ctypes.Structure): pass
FT_Library=ctypes.POINTER(FT_LibraryRec)
class FT_FaceRec(ctypes.Structure): pass
FT_Face=ctypes.POINTER(FT_FaceRec)
FT.FT_Init_FreeType.argtypes=[ctypes.POINTER(FT_Library)]
FT.FT_New_Face.argtypes=[FT_Library, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_long, FT_Face]
FT.FT_Set_Pixel_Sizes.argtypes=[FT_Face, ctypes.c_uint, ctypes.c_uint]
FT.FT_Load_Char.argtypes=[FT_Face, ctypes.c_ulong, ctypes.c_int]
FT.FT_Get_Char_Index.argtypes=[FT_Face, ctypes.c_ulong]
FT.FT_Render_Glyph.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_int]
FT.FT_Done_Face.argtypes=[FT_Face]
FT.FT_Done_FreeType.argtypes=[FT_Library]
# glyph slot struct offsets (x86_64, freetype 2.11)
# We'll access the glyph slot via its known layout using a python class with offsets computed from the header
# Simpler: use FT_GlyphSlotRec layout from freetype/freetype.h:
# struct FT_GlyphSlotRec_ { FT_Glyph_Metrics metrics; FT_Glyph_BitmapRec bitmap; FT_Int bitmap_left; FT_Int bitmap_top; ... }
class FT_Glyph_Metrics(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_=[("width",ctypes.c_long),("height",ctypes.c_long),("horiBearingX",ctypes.c_long),("horiBearingY",ctypes.c_long),("horiAdvance",ctypes.c_long),("vertBearingX",ctypes.c_long),("vertBearingY",ctypes.c_long),("vertAdvance",ctypes.c_long)]
class FT_Bitmap(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_=[("rows",ctypes.c_int),("width",ctypes.c_int),("pitch",ctypes.c_int),("buffer",ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_ubyte)),("num_grays",ctypes.c_short),("pixel_mode",ctypes.c_ubyte),("palette_mode",ctypes.c_ubyte),("palette",ctypes.c_void_p)]
class FT_GlyphSlotRec(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_=[("metrics",FT_Glyph_Metrics),("bitmap",FT_Bitmap),("bitmap_left",ctypes.c_int),("bitmap_top",ctypes.c_int),("advance",ctypes.c_long*2),("format",ctypes.c_int),("linearHoriAdvance",ctypes.c_long),("linearVertAdvance",ctypes.c_long),("advance_x",ctypes.c_long),("advance_y",ctypes.c_long)]
FT_GlyphSlot=ctypes.POINTER(FT_GlyphSlotRec)
FT.FT_New_Face.restype=ctypes.c_int
FT.FT_Init_FreeType.restype=ctypes.c_int
FT.FT_Set_Pixel_Sizes.restype=ctypes.c_int
FT.FT_Load_Char.restype=ctypes.c_int
FT.FT_Render_Glyph.restype=ctypes.c_int
FT.FT_Get_Char_Index.restype=ctypes.c_uint

class Face:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.lib=FT_Library()
        FT.FT_Init_FreeType(ctypes.byref(self.lib))
        self.face=FT_Face()
        r=FT.FT_New_Face(self.lib, path.encode(), 0, ctypes.byref(self.face))
        assert r==0, r
        self.f=self.face.contents
    def setpixel(self, size):
        FT.FT_Set_Pixel_Sizes(self.face, 0, size)
    def charindex(self, ch):
        return FT.FT_Get_Char_Index(self.face, ord(ch))
    def load(self, ch, flags=0):
        ci=self.charindex(ch)
        if ci==0: return None
        r=FT.FT_Load_Char(self.face, ci, flags)
        if r!=0: return None
        slot=ctypes.cast(self.f.glyph, FT_GlyphSlot)
        return slot.contents
    def metrics(self, ch, flags=0):
        ci=self.charindex(ch)
        if ci==0: return None
        FT.FT_Load_Char(self.face, ci, flags)
        slot=ctypes.cast(self.f.glyph, FT_GlyphSlot).contents
        return dict(adv=slot.metrics.horiAdvance/64.0, lsb=slot.metrics.horiBearingX/64.0,
                    inkw=slot.metrics.width/64.0, inkh=slot.metrics.height/64.0,
                    top=slot.metrics.horiBearingY/64.0, left=slot.bitmap_left, btop=slot.bitmap_top)
    def bitmap(self, ch, flags=0x100):  # 0x100 = FT_LOAD_NO_HINTING? actually 0x2 = NO_HINTING
        ci=self.charindex(ch)
        if ci==0: return None
        FT.FT_Load_Char(self.face, ci, flags)
        slot=ctypes.cast(self.f.glyph, FT_GlyphSlot).contents
        bm=slot.bitmap
        rows=bm.rows; wd=bm.width; pitch=bm.pitch
        buf=ctypes.string_at(bm.buffer, pitch*rows)
        out=[]
        for r in range(rows):
            out.append([buf[r*pitch+c] for c in range(wd)])
        return dict(left=slot.bitmap_left, top=slot.bitmap_top, bmp=out)
    def __del__(self):
        try: FT.FT_Done_Face(self.face); FT.FT_Done_FreeType(self.lib)
        except: pass

import struct
class TTF:
    def __init__(self, path):
        d=open(path,'rb').read()
        self.d=d
        n=struct.unpack('>H',d[4:6])[0]
        self.tables={}
        for i in range(n):
            off=12+16*i
            tag=d[off:off+4].decode('latin1')
            o,l=struct.unpack('>II',d[off+8:off+16])
            self.tables[tag]=(o,l)
        o,l=self.tables['head']
        ver,frev,macadj,macmin,fmaje,fminj,macstyle=self.tables and struct.unpack('>HHQQhhhh', d[o:o+24])
        self.unitsPerEm=struct.unpack('>H',d[o+18:o+20])[0]
        o,l=self.tables['hhea']
        self.ascent,self.descent,self.lineGap=struct.unpack('>hhh', d[o+4:o+10])
        self.numberOfHMetrics=struct.unpack('>H',d[o+34:o+36])[0]
        o,l=self.tables['maxp']
        self.numGlyphs=struct.unpack('>H',d[o+4:o+6])[0]
        # hmtx
        o,l=self.tables['hmtx']
        self.adv=[];self.lsb=[]
        pos=o
        for i in range(self.numGlyphs):
            if i<self.numberOfHMetrics:
                aw,lsb=struct.unpack('>Hh', d[pos:pos+4]); pos+=4
            else:
                aw=self.adv[-1]; lsb=struct.unpack('>h', d[pos:pos+2])[0]; pos+=2
            self.adv.append(aw); self.lsb.append(lsb)
        # cmap
        o,l=self.tables['cmap']
        n=struct.unpack('>H',d[o+2:o+4])[0]
        self.map={}
        for i in range(n):
            pid,eid,off=struct.unpack('>HHI', d[o+4+8*i:o+4+8*i+8])
            fmt=struct.unpack('>H',d[o+off:o+off+2])[0]
            if fmt==4:
                segX2=struct.unpack('>H',d[o+off+6:o+off+8])[0]
                seg=segX2//2
                ends=struct.unpack('>%dH'%seg, d[o+off+14:o+off+14+segX2])
                starts=struct.unpack('>%dH'%seg, d[o+off+16+segX2:o+off+16+2*segX2])
                deltas=struct.unpack('>%dh'%seg, d[o+off+16+2*segX2:o+off+16+3*segX2])
                rngoffs=struct.unpack('>%dH'%seg, d[o+off+16+3*segX2:o+off+16+4*segX2])
                base=o+off+16+4*segX2
                for s in range(seg):
                    for c in range(starts[s], min(ends[s],0xFFFF)+1):
                        if rngoffs[s]==0:
                            g=(c+deltas[s])&0xFFFF
                        else:
                            gi=base+2*s+2*(c-starts[s])+rngoffs[s]
                            g=struct.unpack('>H', d[gi:gi+2])[0]
                            if g!=0: g=(g+deltas[s])&0xFFFF
                        if g!=0 and c not in self.map: self.map[c]=g
    def advance(self, ch):
        g=self.map.get(ord(ch))
        if g is None: return None
        return self.adv[g]/self.unitsPerEm
    def lsb(self, ch):
        g=self.map.get(ord(ch))
        if g is None: return None
        return self.lsb[g]/self.unitsPerEm
    def hmetrics(self):
        a=self.ascent/self.unitsPerEm; de=-self.descent/self.unitsPerEm
        return a,de,self.lineGap/self.unitsPerEm

import struct
class TTF:
    def __init__(self, path):
        d=open(path,'rb').read()
        self.d=d
        n=struct.unpack('>H',d[4:6])[0]
        self.tables={}
        for i in range(n):
            off=12+16*i
            tag=d[off:off+4].decode('latin1')
            o,l=struct.unpack('>II',d[off+8:off+16])
            self.tables[tag]=(o,l)
        o,l=self.tables['head']
        ver,frev,macadj,macmin,fmaje,fminj,macstyle=self.tables and struct.unpack('>HHQQhhhh', d[o:o+24])
        self.unitsPerEm=struct.unpack('>H',d[o+18:o+20])[0]
        o,l=self.tables['hhea']
        self.ascent,self.descent,self.lineGap=struct.unpack('>hhh', d[o+4:o+10])
        self.numberOfHMetrics=struct.unpack('>H',d[o+34:o+36])[0]
        o,l=self.tables['maxp']
        self.numGlyphs=struct.unpack('>H',d[o+4:o+6])[0]
        # hmtx
        o,l=self.tables['hmtx']
        self.adv=[];self.lsb=[]
        pos=o
        for i in range(self.numGlyphs):
            if i<self.numberOfHMetrics:
                aw,lsb=struct.unpack('>Hh', d[pos:pos+4]); pos+=4
            else:
                aw=self.adv[-1]; lsb=struct.unpack('>h', d[pos:pos+2])[0]; pos+=2
            self.adv.append(aw); self.lsb.append(lsb)
        # cmap
        o,l=self.tables['cmap']
        n=struct.unpack('>H',d[o+2:o+4])[0]
        self.map={}
        for i in range(n):
            pid,eid,off=struct.unpack('>HHI', d[o+4+8*i:o+4+8*i+8])
            fmt=struct.unpack('>H',d[o+off:o+off+2])[0]
            if fmt==4:
                segX2=struct.unpack('>H',d[o+off+6:o+off+8])[0]
                seg=segX2//2
                ends=struct.unpack('>%dH'%seg, d[o+off+14:o+off+14+segX2])
                starts=struct.unpack('>%dH'%seg, d[o+off+16+segX2:o+off+16+2*segX2])
                deltas=struct.unpack('>%dh'%seg, d[o+off+16+2*segX2:o+off+16+3*segX2])
                rngoffs=struct.unpack('>%dH'%seg, d[o+off+16+3*segX2:o+off+16+4*segX2])
                base=o+off+16+4*segX2
                for s in range(seg):
                    for c in range(starts[s], min(ends[s],0xFFFF)+1):
                        if rngoffs[s]==0:
                            g=(c+deltas[s])&0xFFFF
                        else:
                            gi=base+2*s+2*(c-starts[s])+rngoffs[s]
                            g=struct.unpack('>H', d[gi:gi+2])[0]
                            if g!=0: g=(g+deltas[s])&0xFFFF
                        if g!=0 and c not in self.map: self.map[c]=g
    def advance(self, ch):
        g=self.map.get(ord(ch))
        if g is None: return None
        return self.adv[g]/self.unitsPerEm
    def lsb(self, ch):
        g=self.map.get(ord(ch))
        if g is None: return None
        return self.lsb[g]/self.unitsPerEm
    def hmetrics(self):
        a=self.ascent/self.unitsPerEm; de=-self.descent/self.unitsPerEm
        return a,de,self.lineGap/self.unitsPerEm
EOF

import sys, re
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/t')
from lib import load
from collections import Counter
f=sys.argv[1]; svgf=sys.argv[2]
w,h,px=load(f)
svg=open(svgf).read()
texts=re.findall(r"<text x='(\d+)' y='(\d+)' font-family='Courier' font-size='(\d+)' stroke='none' fill='([^']*)' ><!\[CDATA\[(.*?)\]\]>",svg)
def runs(y,thr=20):
    ink=[254-px[y][x][0] for x in range(w)]
    out=[];cur=None
    for i,v in enumerate(ink):
        if v>thr and cur is None: cur=i
        if v<=thr and cur is not None: out.append((cur,i-1)); cur=None
    if cur is not None: out.append((cur,len(ink)-1))
    return out
for (x,y,size,fill,txt) in texts:
    x0=int(x); s=int(size); ch=txt[0]
    # find glyph rows near y (the svg y ~ baseline+0.5)
    best=None
    for yy in range(int(y)-3, int(y)+3):
        r=[t for t in runs(yy) if t[0]>x0-2]
        if len(r)>=3:
            d=[r[i+1][0]-r[i][0] for i in range(len(r)-1)]
            c=Counter(d).most_common(1)[0][0]
            best=(yy,c,len(r))
            break
    print('%-3s size=%3d  adv=%s  (y=%s n=%s)'%(ch,s,best[1] if best else None, best[0] if best else '', best[2] if best else ''))
EOF
python3 /tmp/t/adv.py /tmp/t/t4.png /tmp/t/t4.svg 2>&1 | head -70

    def glyf_off(self, g):
        o,l=self.tables['loca']
        if self.numGlyphs+1==l//2:  # short loca
            a,b=struct.unpack('>HH', d[o+2*g:o+2*g+4]) if False else struct.unpack('>HH', self.d[o+2*g:o+2*g+4])
            off=self.tables['glyf'][0]+ (a*2)
            end=self.tables['glyf'][0]+ (b*2)
        else:
            a,b=struct.unpack('>II', self.d[o+4*g:o+4*g+8])
            off=self.tables['glyf'][0]+a
            end=self.tables['glyf'][0]+b
        if end<=off: return None
        return (off,end)
    def bbox(self, ch):
        g=self.map.get(ord(ch))
        if g is None: return None
        r=self.glyf_off(g)

        d=self.d
        nc=struct.unpack('>h', d[off:off+2])[0]

        xMin,yMin,xMax,yMax=struct.unpack('>hhhh', d[off+2:off+10])
        nContours=nc

        ends=struct.unpack('>%dH'%nContours, d[pos:pos+2*nContours]); pos+=2*nContours
        instrLen=struct.unpack('>H', d[pos:pos+2])[0]; pos+=2+instrLen
        # flags

                xs.append((cur, True))
            elif fl&16:

        ys=[]

    def glyf_off(self, g):
        o,l=self.tables['loca']
        if self.numGlyphs+1==l//2:  # short loca
            a,b=struct.unpack('>HH', d[o+2*g:o+2*g+4]) if False else struct.unpack('>HH', self.d[o+2*g:o+2*g+4])
            off=self.tables['glyf'][0]+ (a*2)
            end=self.tables['glyf'][0]+ (b*2)
        else:
            a,b=struct.unpack('>II', self.d[o+4*g:o+4*g+8])
            off=self.tables['glyf'][0]+a
            end=self.tables['glyf'][0]+b
        if end<=off: return None
        return (off,end)
    def bbox(self, ch):
        g=self.map.get(ord(ch))
        if g is None: return None
        r=self.glyf_off(g)
        if r is None: return None
        off,end=r
        d=self.d
        nc=struct.unpack('>h', d[off:off+2])[0]
        if nc<0:
            # composite; skip for now
            return None
        xMin,yMin,xMax,yMax=struct.unpack('>hhhh', d[off+2:off+10])
        return (xMin,yMin,xMax,yMax)
    def outline(self, ch):
        g=self.map.get(ord(ch))
        if g is None: return None
        r=self.glyf_off(g)
        if r is None: return None
        off,end=r
        d=self.d
        nc=struct.unpack('>h', d[off:off+2])[0]
        if nc<0: return None
        xMin,yMin,xMax,yMax=struct.unpack('>hhhh', d[off+2:off+10])
        nContours=nc
        pos=off+10
        ends=struct.unpack('>%dH'%nContours, d[pos:pos+2*nContours]); pos+=2*nContours
        instrLen=struct.unpack('>H', d[pos:pos+2])[0]; pos+=2+instrLen
        # flags
        flags=[]
        nPoints=ends[-1]+1
        while len(flags)<nPoints:
            fl=d[pos]; pos+=1
            flags.append(fl)
            if fl&8:
                rep=d[pos]; pos+=1
                flags += [fl]*rep
        flags=flags[:nPoints]
        # x coords
        xs=[]
        cur=0
        for fl in flags:
            if fl&2:
                dx=d[pos]; pos+=1
                if not (fl&16): dx=-dx
                cur+=dx
                xs.append((cur, True))
            elif fl&16:
                cur+=struct.unpack('>h', d[pos:pos+2])[0]; pos+=2
                xs.append((cur, True))
            else:
                cur+=struct.unpack('>h', d[pos:pos+2])[0]; pos+=2
                xs.append((cur, False))
        ys=[]
        cur=0
        for fl in flags:
            if fl&4:
                dy=d[pos]; pos+=1
                if not (fl&32): dy=-dy
                cur+=dy
                ys.append((cur, True))
            elif fl&32:
                cur+=struct.unpack('>h', d[pos:pos+2])[0]; pos+=2
                ys.append((cur, True))
            else:
                cur+=struct.unpack('>h', d[pos:pos+2])[0]; pos+=2
                ys.append((cur, False))
        return dict(nPoints=nPoints, ends=ends, flags=flags, x=xs, y=ys, bbox=(xMin,yMin,xMax,yMax))

def parse_outline(o):
    # returns list of contours, each a list of (x,y) with on/off curve flags
    nP=o['nPoints']; ends=o['ends']; flags=o['flags']; xs=o['x']; ys=o['y']
    pts=[(xs[i][0], ys[i][0], xs[i][1] and ys[i][1]) for i in range(nP)]
    contours=[]
    start=0
    for e in ends:
        contours.append(pts[start:e+1])
        start=e+1
    return contours
def to_curves(contours):
    # convert to list of segments (line/quadratic) with explicit on-curve start
    segs=[]
    for pts in contours:
        # find first on-curve point
        n=len(pts)
        if all(not p[2] for p in pts): continue
        # rotate so that pts[0] is on-curve
        idx=0
        for i,p in enumerate(pts):
            if p[2]: idx=i; break
        pts=pts[idx:]+pts[:idx]
        segs_c=[]
        i=0
        while i<n:
            p0=pts[i%n]
            # next point
            j=(i+1)%n
            p1=pts[j]
            if p1[2]:
                segs_c.append(('L',p0[0],p0[1],p1[0],p1[1]))
                i=j
            else:
                k=(j+1)%n
                p2=pts[k]
                segs_c.append(('Q',p0[0],p0[1],p1[0],p1[1],p2[0],p2[1]))
                i=k
        segs.append(segs_c)
    return segs
def rasterize(segs, ox, oy, w, h, sub=8):
    # segs in font units scaled to pixels; ox, oy = origin offset in pixels
    # returns coverage grid h x w (floats 0..1)
    # Build polygons by flattening the curves
    polys=[]
    for c in segs:
        pts=[]
        prev=None
        for s in c:
            if s[0]=='L':
                p=(s[1],s[2]); q=(s[3],s[4])
                if prev is None: pts.append(p)
                elif prev!=p: pts.append(p)
                pts.append(q); prev=q
            else:
                p0=(s[1],s[2]); p1=(s[3],s[4]); p2=(s[5],s[6])
                if prev is None: pts.append(p0)
                elif prev!=p0: pts.append(p0)
                # flatten quadratic with 8 steps
                for t in range(1,9):
                    u=t/8.0
                    x=(1-u)**2*p0[0]+2*(1-u)*u*p1[0]+u*u*p2[0]
                    y=(1-u)**2*p0[1]+2*(1-u)*u*p1[1]+u*u*p2[1]
                    pts.append((x,y))
                prev=(p2)
        polys.append(pts)
    # rasterize each pixel with supersampling
    cov=[[0.0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    dx=1.0/sub; dy=1.0/sub
    step=0
    for py in range(h):
        for px_ in range(w):
            cnt=0
            for i in range(sub):
                sy=py+(i+0.5)*dy + oy
                # count crossings for each polygon using even-odd on the polygon containing point
                for poly in polys:
                    inside=False
                    n=len(poly)
                    for k in range(n):
                        x1,y1=poly[k]; x2,y2=poly[(k+1)%n]
                        if (y1<=sy<y2) or (y2<=sy<y1):
                            t=(sy-y1)/(y2-y1)
                            xx=x1+t*(x2-x1)
                            if xx < px_+(0.5)*dx:  # ray to -infinity
                                inside=not inside
                    if inside: cnt+=1
            cov[py][px_]=cnt/(sub*sub)
    return cov

def parse_outline(o):
    # returns list of contours, each a list of (x,y) with on/off curve flags
    nP=o['nPoints']; ends=o['ends']; flags=o['flags']; xs=o['x']; ys=o['y']
    pts=[(xs[i][0], ys[i][0], xs[i][1] and ys[i][1]) for i in range(nP)]
    contours=[]
    start=0
    for e in ends:
        contours.append(pts[start:e+1])
        start=e+1
    return contours
def to_curves(contours):
    # convert to list of segments (line/quadratic) with explicit on-curve start
    segs=[]
    for pts in contours:
        # find first on-curve point
        n=len(pts)
        if all(not p[2] for p in pts): continue
        # rotate so that pts[0] is on-curve
        idx=0
        for i,p in enumerate(pts):
            if p[2]: idx=i; break
        pts=pts[idx:]+pts[:idx]
        segs_c=[]
        i=0
        while i<n:
            p0=pts[i%n]
            # next point
            j=(i+1)%n
            p1=pts[j]
            if p1[2]:
                segs_c.append(('L',p0[0],p0[1],p1[0],p1[1]))
                i=j
            else:
                k=(j+1)%n
                p2=pts[k]
                segs_c.append(('Q',p0[0],p0[1],p1[0],p1[1],p2[0],p2[1]))
                i=k
        segs.append(segs_c)
    return segs
def rasterize(segs, ox, oy, w, h, sub=8):
    # segs in font units scaled to pixels; ox, oy = origin offset in pixels
    # returns coverage grid h x w (floats 0..1)
    # Build polygons by flattening the curves
    polys=[]
    for c in segs:
        pts=[]
        prev=None
        for s in c:
            if s[0]=='L':
                p=(s[1],s[2]); q=(s[3],s[4])
                if prev is None: pts.append(p)
                elif prev!=p: pts.append(p)
                pts.append(q); prev=q
            else:
                p0=(s[1],s[2]); p1=(s[3],s[4]); p2=(s[5],s[6])
                if prev is None: pts.append(p0)
                elif prev!=p0: pts.append(p0)
                # flatten quadratic with 8 steps
                for t in range(1,9):
                    u=t/8.0
                    x=(1-u)**2*p0[0]+2*(1-u)*u*p1[0]+u*u*p2[0]
                    y=(1-u)**2*p0[1]+2*(1-u)*u*p1[1]+u*u*p2[1]
                    pts.append((x,y))
                prev=(p2)
        polys.append(pts)
    # rasterize each pixel with supersampling
    cov=[[0.0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    dx=1.0/sub; dy=1.0/sub
    step=0
    for py in range(h):
        for px_ in range(w):
            cnt=0
            for i in range(sub):
                sy=py+(i+0.5)*dy + oy
                # count crossings for each polygon using even-odd on the polygon containing point
                for poly in polys:
                    inside=False
                    n=len(poly)
                    for k in range(n):
                        x1,y1=poly[k]; x2,y2=poly[(k+1)%n]
                        if (y1<=sy<y2) or (y2<=sy<y1):
                            t=(sy-y1)/(y2-y1)
                            xx=x1+t*(x2-x1)
                            if xx < px_+(0.5)*dx:  # ray to -infinity
                                inside=not inside
                    if inside: cnt+=1
            cov[py][px_]=cnt/(sub*sub)
    return cov

        for s in c:
            if s[0]=='L': pts+= [s[1],s[2],s[3],s[4]]
            else: pts+= [s[1],s[2],s[3],s[4],s[5],s[6]]
    xs=[pts[i]*scale for i in range(0,len(pts),2)]
    ys=[pts[i]*scale for i in range(1,len(pts),2)]
    xmin=min(xs)-pad; xmax=max(xs)+pad
    ymin=min(ys)-pad; ymax=max(ys)+pad
    w=int(math.ceil(xmax-xmin)); h=int(math.ceil(ymax-ymin))
    cov=rasterize(curves, -xmin, ymax, w, h, sub)

    for y in range(h):
        print(''.join('%3d'%round(254*c) for c in cov[y]))

def to_curves(contours):
    segs=[]
    for pts in contours:

        if all_off and n%2==1:

            for i in range(n):

                newp.append(((a[0]+b[0])/2.0,(a[1]+b[1])/2.0, True))
            pts=newp
            n=len(pts)
        if all(not p[2] for p in pts): continue
        idx=0
        for i,p in enumerate(pts):
            if p[2]: idx=i; break
        pts=pts[idx:]+pts[:idx]
        segs_c=[]
        i=0
        while i<n:
            p0=pts[i%n]
            j=(i+1)%n
            p1=pts[j]
            if p1[2]:
                segs_c.append(('L',p0[0],p0[1],p1[0],p1[1]))
                i=j
            else:

                p2=pts[k]
                segs_c.append(('Q',p0[0],p0[1],p1[0],p1[1],p2[0],p2[1]))
                i=k
        segs.append(segs_c)

def flatten(curves, steps=16):
    polys=[]
    for c in curves:
        pts=[]
        prev=None
        for s in c:
            if s[0]=='L':
                p=(s[1],s[2]); q=(s[3],s[4])
                if prev is None: pts.append(p)
                elif prev!=p: pts.append(p)
                pts.append(q); prev=q
            else:
                p0=(s[1],s[2]); p1=(s[3],s[4]); p2=(s[5],s[6])
                if prev is None: pts.append(p0)
                elif prev!=p0: pts.append(p0)
                for t in range(1,steps+1):
                    u=t/steps
                    x=(1-u)**2*p0[0]+2*(1-u)*u*p1[0]+u*u*p2[0]
                    y=(1-u)**2*p0[1]+2*(1-u)*u*p1[1]+u*u*p2[1]
                    pts.append((x,y))

import sys, subprocess
def run(lines, name):
    open('/tmp/t/%s.txt'%name,'w').write('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
    subprocess.run(['./executable','--svg','/tmp/t/%s.txt'%name,'/tmp/t/%s.svg'%name], capture_output=True)
    import re
    svg=open('/tmp/t/%s.svg'%name).read()
    texts=re.findall(r"<text x='(\d+)' y='(\d+)' font-family='Courier' font-size='(\d+)' stroke='none' fill='([^']*)' ><!\[CDATA\[(.*?)\]\]>",svg)
    paths=re.findall(r"<path[^>]*d='([^']*)'",svg)
    return texts, paths, svg
EOF

    w,h,px=load('/tmp/t/%s.png'%name)
    def runs(y,thr=20):
        ink=[254-px[y][x][0] for x in range(w)]
        out=[];cur=None
        for i,v in enumerate(ink):
            if v>thr and cur is None: cur=i
            if v<=thr and cur is not None: out.append((cur,i-1)); cur=None
        if cur is not None: out.append((cur,len(ink)-1))
        return out
    print('texts:', [(int(x),int(y),int(s),c) for x,y,s,f,c in texts])
    for (x,y,s,f,c) in texts:

        if not rr: continue
        ymid=(min(rr)+max(rr))//2
        r=runs(ymid)

def measure(lines, name='q'):
    open('/tmp/t/%s.txt'%name,'w').write('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
    for ext,extra in [('.svg',['--svg']),('.png',[])]:
        subprocess.run(['./executable']+extra+['/tmp/t/%s.txt'%name,'/tmp/t/%s%s'%(name,ext)],capture_output=True)
    svg=open('/tmp/t/%s.svg'%name).read()
    texts=re.findall(r"<text x='(\d+)' y='(\d+)' font-family='Courier' font-size='(\d+)' stroke='none' fill='([^']*)' ><!\[CDATA\[(.*?)\]\]>",svg)
    w,h,px=load('/tmp/t/%s.png'%name)
    def runs(y,thr=20):
        ink=[254-px[y][x][0] for x in range(w)]
        out=[];cur=None
        for i,v in enumerate(ink):

            if v<=thr and cur is not None: out.append((cur,i-1)); cur=None

    print('texts:', [(int(x),int(y),int(s),c) for x,y,s,f,c in texts])
    for (x,y,s,f,c) in texts:

def measure(lines, name='q', verbose=True):

    subprocess.run(['./executable','--svg','/tmp/t/%s.txt'%name,'/tmp/t/%s.svg'%name],capture_output=True)
    subprocess.run(['./executable','/tmp/t/%s.txt'%name,'/tmp/t/%s.png'%name],capture_output=True)
    svg=open('/tmp/t/%s.svg'%name).read()
    texts=re.findall(r"<text x='(\d+)' y='(\d+)' font-family='Courier' font-size='(\d+)' stroke='none' fill='([^']*)' ><!\[CDATA\[(.*?)\]\]>",svg)
    w,h,px=load('/tmp/t/%s.png'%name)
    def runs(y,thr=20):
        ink=[254-px[y][x][0] for x in range(w)]
        out=[];cur=None
        for i,v in enumerate(ink):
            if v>thr and cur is None: cur=i
            if v<=thr and cur is not None: out.append((cur,i-1)); cur=None
        if cur is not None: out.append((cur,len(ink)-1))
        return out
    out=[]
    for (x,y,sz,f,c) in texts:
        xi=int(x); yi=int(y); s=int(sz)
        rr=[y2 for y2 in range(max(0,yi-s), min(h,yi+s)) if any(px[y2][x2][0]<234 for x2 in range(max(0,xi-2), min(w,xi+4*s)))]
        if not rr: continue
        ymid=(min(rr)+max(rr))//2
        r=runs(ymid)
        r=[t for t in r if t[0]>=xi-4][:10]
        if verbose:
            print('  svg(x=%d,y=%d,s=%d) "%s" inkrows %d..%d runs@%d: %s'%(xi,yi,s,c,min(rr),max(rr),ymid,r))
        out.append((xi,yi,s,c,r))
    return out

def dash_path(path, dash_on, dash_off):
    """Split each contour into sub-contours according to a dash pattern."""

    dx = s[3] - s[1]
    dy = s[4] - s[2]
    return (s[1] + dx * t, s[2] + dy * t)

import zlib, struct


def write_png(path, canvas):
    w = canvas.width
    h = canvas.height
    buf = canvas.buf
    raw = bytearray()
    for y in range(h):
        raw.append(0)
        o = y * w * 4
        raw.extend(buf[o:o + w * 4])

    def chunk(tag, data):
        c = struct.pack('>I', len(data)) + tag + data
        c += struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(tag + data) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
        return c

    ihdr = struct.pack('>IIBBBBB', w, h, 8, 6, 0, 0, 0)
    data = b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n' + chunk(b'IHDR', ihdr) + chunk(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(bytes(raw), 6)) + chunk(b'IEND', b'')
    with open(path, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(data)


def read_png(path):
    d = open(path, 'rb').read()
    assert d[:8] == b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
    i = 8
    idat = b''
    while i < len(d):
        ln = struct.unpack('>I', d[i:i + 4])[0]
        typ = d[i + 4:i + 8]
        data = d[i + 8:i + 8 + ln]
        if typ == b'IHDR':
            w, h, bd, ct, cm, fm, il = struct.unpack('>IIBBBBB', data)
        elif typ == b'IDAT':
            idat += data
        i += 12 + ln
    raw = zlib.decompress(idat)
    bpp = {0: 1, 2: 3, 4: 2, 6: 4}[ct]
    stride = w * bpp
    out = bytearray(h * stride)
    prev = bytearray(stride)
    pos = 0
    for y in range(h):
        f = raw[pos]; pos += 1
        line = bytearray(raw[pos:pos + stride]); pos += stride
        if f == 1:
            for x in range(bpp, stride):
                line[x] = (line[x] + line[x - bpp]) & 255
        elif f == 2:
            for x in range(stride):
                line[x] = (line[x] + prev[x]) & 255
        elif f == 3:
            for x in range(stride):
                a = line[x - bpp] if x >= bpp else 0
                line[x] = (line[x] + ((a + prev[x]) >> 1)) & 255
        elif f == 4:
            for x in range(stride):
                a = line[x - bpp] if x >= bpp else 0
                b = prev[x]
                c = prev[x - bpp] if x >= bpp else 0
                p = a + b - c
                pa = abs(p - a); pb = abs(p - b); pc = abs(p - c)
                pr = a if (pa <= pb and pa <= pc) else (b if pb <= pc else c)
                line[x] = (line[x] + pr) & 255
        out[y * stride:(y + 1) * stride] = line
        prev = line
    px = [[tuple(out[y * stride + x * bpp:y * stride + x * bpp + bpp]) for x in range(w)] for y in range(h)]
    return w, h, px

import zlib, struct


def write_png(path, canvas):
    w = canvas.width
    h = canvas.height
    buf = canvas.buf
    raw = bytearray()
    for y in range(h):
        raw.append(0)
        o = y * w * 4
        raw.extend(buf[o:o + w * 4])

    def chunk(tag, data):
        c = struct.pack('>I', len(data)) + tag + data
        c += struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(tag + data) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
        return c

    ihdr = struct.pack('>IIBBBBB', w, h, 8, 6, 0, 0, 0)
    data = b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n' + chunk(b'IHDR', ihdr) + chunk(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(bytes(raw), 6)) + chunk(b'IEND', b'')
    with open(path, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(data)


def read_png(path):
    d = open(path, 'rb').read()
    assert d[:8] == b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
    i = 8
    idat = b''
    while i < len(d):
        ln = struct.unpack('>I', d[i:i + 4])[0]
        typ = d[i + 4:i + 8]
        data = d[i + 8:i + 8 + ln]
        if typ == b'IHDR':
            w, h, bd, ct, cm, fm, il = struct.unpack('>IIBBBBB', data)
        elif typ == b'IDAT':
            idat += data
        i += 12 + ln
    raw = zlib.decompress(idat)
    bpp = {0: 1, 2: 3, 4: 2, 6: 4}[ct]
    stride = w * bpp
    out = bytearray(h * stride)
    prev = bytearray(stride)
    pos = 0
    for y in range(h):
        f = raw[pos]; pos += 1
        line = bytearray(raw[pos:pos + stride]); pos += stride
        if f == 1:
            for x in range(bpp, stride):
                line[x] = (line[x] + line[x - bpp]) & 255
        elif f == 2:
            for x in range(stride):
                line[x] = (line[x] + prev[x]) & 255
        elif f == 3:
            for x in range(stride):
                a = line[x - bpp] if x >= bpp else 0
                line[x] = (line[x] + ((a + prev[x]) >> 1)) & 255
        elif f == 4:
            for x in range(stride):
                a = line[x - bpp] if x >= bpp else 0
                b = prev[x]
                c = prev[x - bpp] if x >= bpp else 0
                p = a + b - c
                pa = abs(p - a); pb = abs(p - b); pc = abs(p - c)
                pr = a if (pa <= pb and pa <= pc) else (b if pb <= pc else c)
                line[x] = (line[x] + pr) & 255
        out[y * stride:(y + 1) * stride] = line
        prev = line
    px = [[tuple(out[y * stride + x * bpp:y * stride + x * bpp + bpp]) for x in range(w)] for y in range(h)]
    return w, h, px

{"command": "cd /workspace && cat > src/diagram.py <<'PYEOF'
"""Main diagram pipeline: grid -> shapes -> rendering -> PNG."""
import math, os, sys
from raster import Canvas, coverage_of, ensure_positive
from stroke import path_to_polys, dash_path
from pngio import write_png
from colors import COLOR_CODES, DARK_CODES, LIGHT_CODES
from grid import TextGrid, LINE_CHARS, ARROWS

SEPARATION = 2


def expand_tabs(lines, tab):
    out = []
    for line in lines:
        parts = line.split('\t')
        s = ''
        for p in parts:
            s += p
            s += ' ' * (tab - len(s) % tab) if parts.index(p) != len(parts) - 1 else ''
        out.append(s.replace('\t', ''))
    return out


def read_lines(path, encoding='UTF-8', tab=8):
    with open(path, 'rb') as f:
        data = f.read()
    try:
        text = data.decode(encoding)
    except Exception:
        text = data.decode('latin-1')
    lines = text.split('\n')
    while lines and lines[-1].strip('\r\n ') == '':
        lines.pop()
    lines = [l.rstrip('\r').replace('\t', ' ' * tab) for l in lines]
    lines = expand_tabs_tabaware(lines, tab)
    return lines


def expand_tabs_tabaware(lines, tab):
    res = []
    for line in lines:
        if '\t' in line:
            s = ''
            for ch in line:
                if ch == '\t':
                    s += ' ' * (tab - len(s) % tab)
                else:
                    s += ch
            res.append(s)
        else:
            res.append(line)
    return res


class Diagram:
    def __init__(self, lines, opts):
        self.opts = opts
        self.scale = opts.scale
        self.cellW = 10 * opts.scale
        self.cellH = 14 * opts.scale
        self.offX = 2 * self.cellW
        self.offY = 2 * self.cellH
        self.width = int(round((TextGrid(lines).width + 4) * self.cellW)) if lines else 40
        self.height = int(round((len(lines) + 4) * self.cellH)) if lines else 56
        self.grid = TextGrid(lines)
        self.canvas = Canvas(self.width, self.height)
        self.shapes = []
        self.open_paths = []
        self.texts = []
        self.arrows = []

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ geometry
    def cx(self, col):
        return self.offX + (col + 0.5) * self.cellW

    def cy(self, row):
        return self.offY + (row + 0.5) * self.cellH

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ rendering
    def render(self):
        bg = self.opts.backgroundColor
        self.canvas.clear((bg[0] - 1, bg[1] - 1, bg[2] - 1))
        if self.opts.transparent:
            pass
        self.canvas.clear_border(bg)
        self._find_all()
        self._draw_shadows()
        self._draw_shapes()
        self._draw_open_paths()
        self._draw_text()

    def _find_all(self):
        grid = self.grid
        W, H = grid.width, grid.height
        # classify cells
        def isline(x, y):
            return grid.get(x, y) in LINE_CHARS
        # regions: flood fill non-line cells bounded by line cells
        seen = [[False] * W for _ in range(H)]
        regions = []
        for y in range(H):
            for x in range(W):
                if seen[y][x]:
                    continue
                if isline(x, y):
                    seen[y][x] = True
                    continue
                # flood fill
                stack = [(x, y)]
                cells = []
                seen[y][x] = True
                while stack:
                    cx, cy = stack.pop()
                    cells.append((cx, cy))
                    for dx, dy in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                        nx, ny = cx + dx, cy + dy
                        if 0 <= nx < W and 0 <= ny < H and not seen[ny][nx] and not isline(nx, ny):
                            seen[ny][nx] = True
                            stack.append((nx, ny))
                regions.append(cells)
        self.regions = regions

    def _region_bounds(self, cells):
        xs = [c[0] for c in cells]
        ys = [c[1] for c in cells]
        return min(xs), min(ys), max(xs), max(ys)


def render_file(opts):
    from font import FontMeasurer
    lines = read_lines(opts.infile, opts.encoding, opts.tabSize)
    d = Diagram(lines, opts)
    d.render()
    if opts.svg:
        write_svg(opts.outfile, d, opts)
    else:
        write_png(opts.outfile, d.canvas)
PYEOF

"""Main diagram pipeline: grid -> shapes -> rendering -> PNG."""
import math, os, sys
from raster import Canvas, coverage_of, ensure_positive
from stroke import path_to_polys, dash_path
from pngio import write_png
from colors import COLOR_CODES, DARK_CODES, LIGHT_CODES
from grid import TextGrid, LINE_CHARS, ARROWS

SEPARATION = 2


def expand_tabs(lines, tab):
    out = []
    for line in lines:
        parts = line.split('\t')
        s = ''
        for p in parts:
            s += p
            s += ' ' * (tab - len(s) % tab) if parts.index(p) != len(parts) - 1 else ''
        out.append(s.replace('\t', ''))
    return out


def read_lines(path, encoding='UTF-8', tab=8):
    with open(path, 'rb') as f:
        data = f.read()
    try:
        text = data.decode(encoding)
    except Exception:
        text = data.decode('latin-1')
    lines = text.split('\n')
    while lines and lines[-1].strip('\r\n ') == '':
        lines.pop()
    lines = [l.rstrip('\r').replace('\t', ' ' * tab) for l in lines]
    lines = expand_tabs_tabaware(lines, tab)
    return lines


def expand_tabs_tabaware(lines, tab):
    res = []
    for line in lines:
        if '\t' in line:
            s = ''
            for ch in line:
                if ch == '\t':
                    s += ' ' * (tab - len(s) % tab)
                else:
                    s += ch
            res.append(s)
        else:
            res.append(line)
    return res


class Diagram:
    def __init__(self, lines, opts):
        self.opts = opts
        self.scale = opts.scale
        self.cellW = 10 * opts.scale
        self.cellH = 14 * opts.scale
        self.offX = 2 * self.cellW
        self.offY = 2 * self.cellH
        self.width = int(round((TextGrid(lines).width + 4) * self.cellW)) if lines else 40
        self.height = int(round((len(lines) + 4) * self.cellH)) if lines else 56
        self.grid = TextGrid(lines)
        self.canvas = Canvas(self.width, self.height)
        self.shapes = []
        self.open_paths = []
        self.texts = []
        self.arrows = []

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ geometry
    def cx(self, col):
        return self.offX + (col + 0.5) * self.cellW

    def cy(self, row):
        return self.offY + (row + 0.5) * self.cellH

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ rendering
    def render(self):
        bg = self.opts.backgroundColor
        self.canvas.clear((bg[0] - 1, bg[1] - 1, bg[2] - 1))
        if self.opts.transparent:
            pass
        self.canvas.clear_border(bg)
        self._find_all()
        self._draw_shadows()
        self._draw_shapes()
        self._draw_open_paths()
        self._draw_text()

    def _find_all(self):
        grid = self.grid
        W, H = grid.width, grid.height
        # classify cells
        def isline(x, y):
            return grid.get(x, y) in LINE_CHARS
        # regions: flood fill non-line cells bounded by line cells
        seen = [[False] * W for _ in range(H)]
        regions = []
        for y in range(H):
            for x in range(W):
                if seen[y][x]:
                    continue
                if isline(x, y):
                    seen[y][x] = True
                    continue
                # flood fill
                stack = [(x, y)]
                cells = []
                seen[y][x] = True
                while stack:
                    cx, cy = stack.pop()
                    cells.append((cx, cy))
                    for dx, dy in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                        nx, ny = cx + dx, cy + dy
                        if 0 <= nx < W and 0 <= ny < H and not seen[ny][nx] and not isline(nx, ny):
                            seen[ny][nx] = True
                            stack.append((nx, ny))
                regions.append(cells)
        self.regions = regions

    def _region_bounds(self, cells):
        xs = [c[0] for c in cells]
        ys = [c[1] for c in cells]
        return min(xs), min(ys), max(xs), max(ys)


def render_file(opts):
    from font import FontMeasurer
    lines = read_lines(opts.infile, opts.encoding, opts.tabSize)
    d = Diagram(lines, opts)
    d.render()
    if opts.svg:
        write_svg(opts.outfile, d, opts)
    else:
        write_png(opts.outfile, d.canvas)
PYEOF

"""Font metrics and glyph rendering via the DejaVu Sans font file."""
import math, struct, os

FONT_PATH = '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf'


class TTF:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.path = path
        self.load()

    def load(self):
        d = open(self.path, 'rb').read()
        self.d = d
        n = struct.unpack('>H', d[4:6])[0]
        self.tables = {}
        for i in range(n):
            off = 12 + 16 * i
            tag = d[off:off + 4].decode('latin1')
            o, l = struct.unpack('>II', d[off + 8:off + 16])
            self.tables[tag] = (o, l)
        o, l = self.tables['head']
        self.unitsPerEm = struct.unpack('>H', d[o + 18:o + 20])[0]
        o, l = self.tables['hhea']
        self.ascent, self.descent, self.lineGap = struct.unpack('>hhh', d[o + 4:o + 10])
        self.numberOfHMetrics = struct.unpack('>H', d[o + 34:o + 36])[0]
        o, l = self.tables['maxp']
        self.numGlyphs = struct.unpack('>H', d[o + 4:o + 6])[0]
        o, l = self.tables['hmtx']
        self.adv = []
        self.lsb = []
        pos = o
        for i in range(self.numGlyphs):
            if i < self.numberOfHMetrics:
                aw, ls = struct.unpack('>Hh', d[pos:pos + 4]); pos += 4
            else:
                aw = self.adv[-1]
                ls = struct.unpack('>h', d[pos:pos + 2])[0]; pos += 2
            self.adv.append(aw); self.lsb.append(ls)
        o, l = self.tables['cmap']
        n = struct.unpack('>H', d[o + 2:o + 4])[0]
        self.map = {}
        for i in range(n):
            pid, eid, off = struct.unpack('>HHI', d[o + 4 + 8 * i:o + 4 + 8 * i + 8])
            fmt = struct.unpack('>H', d[o + off:o + off + 2])[0]
            if fmt == 4:
                segX2 = struct.unpack('>H', d[o + off + 6:o + off + 8])[0]
                seg = segX2 // 2
                ends = struct.unpack('>%dH' % seg, d[o + off + 14:o + off + 14 + segX2])
                starts = struct.unpack('>%dH' % seg, d[o + off + 16 + segX2:o + off + 16 + 2 * segX2])
                deltas = struct.unpack('>%dh' % seg, d[o + off + 16 + 2 * segX2:o + off + 16 + 3 * segX2])
                rngoffs = struct.unpack('>%dH' % seg, d[o + off + 16 + 3 * segX2:o + off + 16 + 4 * segX2])
                base = o + off + 16 + 4 * segX2
                for s in range(seg):
                    for c in range(starts[s], min(ends[s], 0xFFFF) + 1):
                        if rngoffs[s] == 0:
                            g = (c + deltas[s]) & 0xFFFF
                        else:
                            gi = base + 2 * s + 2 * (c - starts[s]) + rngoffs[s]
                            g = struct.unpack('>H', d[gi:gi + 2])[0]
                            if g != 0:
                                g = (g + deltas[s]) & 0xFFFF
                        if g != 0 and c not in self.map:
                            self.map[c] = g

    def glyf_off(self, g):
        o, l = self.tables['loca']
        if self.numGlyphs + 1 == l // 2:
            a, b = struct.unpack('>HH', self.d[o + 2 * g:o + 2 * g + 4])
            off = self.tables['glyf'][0] + (a * 2)
            end = self.tables['glyf'][0] + (b * 2)
        else:
            a, b = struct.unpack('>II', self.d[o + 4 * g:o + 4 * g + 8])
            off = self.tables['glyf'][0] + a
            end = self.tables['glyf'][0] + b
        if end <= off:
            return None
        return (off, end)

    def outline(self, ch):
        g = self.map.get(ord(ch))
        if g is None:
            return None
        r = self.glyf_off(g)
        if r is None:
            return None
        off, end = r
        d = self.d
        nc = struct.unpack('>h', d[off:off + 2])[0]
        if nc < 0:
            return None
        xMin, yMin, xMax, yMax = struct.unpack('>hhhh', d[off + 2:off + 10])
        pos = off + 10
        ends = struct.unpack('>%dH' % nc, d[pos:pos + 2 * nc]); pos += 2 * nc
        instrLen = struct.unpack('>H', d[pos:pos + 2])[0]; pos += 2 + instrLen
        flags = []
        nPoints = ends[-1] + 1
        while len(flags) < nPoints:
            fl = d[pos]; pos += 1
            flags.append(fl)
            if fl & 8:
                rep = d[pos]; pos += 1
                flags += [fl] * rep
        flags = flags[:nPoints]
        xs = []
        oncurve = []
        cur = 0
        for fl in flags:
            oncurve.append(bool(fl & 1))
            if fl & 2:
                dx = d[pos]; pos += 1
                if not (fl & 16):
                    dx = -dx
                cur += dx
            elif fl & 16:
                pass
            else:
                cur += struct.unpack('>h', d[pos:pos + 2])[0]; pos += 2
            xs.append(cur)
        ys = []
        cur = 0
        for fl in flags:
            if fl & 4:
                dy = d[pos]; pos += 1
                if not (fl & 32):
                    dy = -dy
                cur += dy
            elif fl & 32:
                pass
            else:
                cur += struct.unpack('>h', d[pos:pos + 2])[0]; pos += 2
            ys.append(cur)
        return dict(nPoints=nPoints, ends=ends, x=xs, y=ys, oncurve=oncurve, bbox=(xMin, yMin, xMax, yMax))

    def contours(self, ch):
        o = self.outline(ch)
        if o is None:
            return None
        nP = o['nPoints']; ends = o['ends']
        xs = o['x']; ys = o['y']; on = o['oncurve']
        pts = [(xs[i], ys[i], on[i]) for i in range(nP)]
        res = []
        start = 0
        for e in ends:
            res.append(pts[start:e + 1])
            start = e + 1
        return res

    def advance(self, ch, size):
        g = self.map.get(ord(ch))
        if g is None:
            return size * 0.6
        return self.adv[g] * size / self.unitsPerEm

    def lsb(self, ch, size):
        g = self.map.get(ord(ch))
        if g is None:
            return 0.0
        return self.lsb[g] * size / self.unitsPerEm


_font = None


def get_font():
    global _font
    if _font is None:
        _font = TTF(FONT_PATH)
    return _font


class FontMeasurer:
    def __init__(self, scale):
        self.scale = scale
        self.font = get_font()

    def width_for(self, text, font_size):
        f = self.font
        return sum(f.advance(c, font_size) for c in text)
PYEOF

        self.opts = opts
        self.scale = opts.scale
        self.cellW = 10 * opts.scale
        self.cellH = 14 * opts.scale
        self.offX = 2 * self.cellW
        self.offY = 2 * self.cellH
        g = TextGrid(lines)
        self.grid = g
        self.width = int(round((g.width + 4) * self.cellW))
        self.height = int(round((g.height + 4) * self.cellH))

        self.shapes = []
        self.lines_paths = []
        self.text_blocks = []
        self.arrowheads = []
        self._analyse()

    def cx(self, col):
